text:
Aditi: Heads-up — ran a production replay of the long-context summarization workload and saw steady KV residency growth for tenant T-27, culminating in repeated soft-evictions and tail latency spikes. attaching quick logs below. :frowning:

Sam: can you paste the command / replay id? want to repro locally. :mag:

Aditi: replay id `replay/2026-03-03-LC-018`
Aditi: logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-03T09:12:01Z] tenant=T-27 kv_resident_bytes=4.3G
[2026-03-03T09:12:11Z] tenant=T-27 kv_resident_bytes=4.8G
[2026-03-03T09:12:21Z] tenant=T-27 kv_resident_bytes=5.6G
[2026-03-03T09:12:31Z] eviction=soft tenant=T-99 pages=120
[2026-03-03T09:12:33Z] latency_p95=320ms route=generate
```

Aditi: flamegraph attached in the replay run — hot path is `kv.page_walk` + `kv.metadata_lock` during long ctx token appends. Reuse looks low; pages are being appended not reused.

Lee: hmm this sounds like fragmentation + insertion bias. longctx workloads append many unique keys (per-turn KV shards) so residency grows linearly. did you check page reuse ratio?

Aditi: reuse ratio (approx): T-27: 8% over 30min window. cluster median tenants: ~42%.

Jordan: low reuse for a single tenant + high residency explains noisy neighbor symptoms. we should consider a per-tenant soft watermark and background compaction when tenant hits watermark. two quick ideas:
- soft quota: signal tenant nearing watermark -> stop prefetch, lower per-request pre-alloc pages, switch to slab-compact mode
- proactive compaction: async GC that merges underutilized pages during low CPU windows

Sam: +1. also consider changing eviction policy to be tenant-weighted LRU where weight = residency * (1 + recent_reuse_penalty). prevents evicting small tenants unfairly. pseudocode idea:
```
rank = last_access_time / (1 + reuse_ratio)
evict_lowest_rank_until_under_watermark(tenant)
```

Nisha: ops-bot shows node pressure spikes at same times. ops-bot: `node=run-usa-12 mem_pressure=high kv_paging=active` matched with those timestamps. we should throttle large single-tenant bursts before eviction cascade. :exclamation:

Jordan: experiment plan proposal:
1) add per-tenant soft watermark signal (emit metric `kv.soft_watermark_hits`)
2) when hit, reduce per-request page reservation from 8 -> 2 for that tenant for next 30s
3) schedule compaction job with low-cpu niceness for tenant pages older than 60s
4) change eviction ranking to tenant-weighted LRU in simulation and run against replay/2026-03-03-LC-018

Aditi: I'll start a sim run with tenant-weighted LRU + soft-watermark step 2 and post results. initial thought: should reduce noisy evictions by lowering peak residency and giving background compaction time.

Sam: please capture metrics: `kv.residency_per_tenant`, `kv.reuse_ratio`, `kv.eviction_count`, `latency_p95_by_tenant`. can we add a flamegraph for compaction task to ensure it doesn't spike latency?

Aditi: will do. running now (local sim) — ETA ~20m.

ops-bot: deploybot: simulated patch applied to staging cluster: rtx-kv/tenant-watermarks-ephemeral (sha: d4e5f).

Aditi: quick sim snapshot after 20m: T-27 residency peak down from 5.6G -> 3.2G, reuse ratio up 8% -> 26%, attacker tenant eviction events reduced from 7->1, cluster tail p95 down ~70ms. preliminary but promising. :tada:

Lee: awesome. next steps: run longer replay + run on a 10x mix of tenants to ensure no regressions for small tenants. also add circuit-breaker to avoid compaction storms.

Jordan: can someone open a short RFC with config knobs (soft watermark thresholds, reservation reduction magnitude, compaction niceness) and a rollback plan? don't want surprises in Dedicated customers.

Aditi: filing RFC now — will include metrics dashboard, sim configs, and rollback gates. assigning follow-ups in RFC.

Sam: great. thanks for repro and data. keep ops-bot in the loop.

Nisha: marking for eng-oncall to watch next 48h after staged rollout. ops-bot will post alerts if `kv.soft_watermark_hits` > 3 for >5m.

Aditi: thanks all — will post RFC link when ready. :white_check_mark:
